chapter_title_en: The Emperor’s Gaze and the True Immortal’s Fury
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch 496: Ji Ning Shocks the Xia Emperor & Faces a True Immortal's Wrath
chapter_meta_description: The Xia Emperor witnesses Ji Ning shatter a legendary formation and sees a priceless future ally. But a furious True Immortal arrives, forcing Ji Ning to unleash the seven arrows of the Houyi Archery Art in a desperate bid for survival!
og_description: A Void Fiendgod shatters a Celestial Immortal formation and draws the attention of the Grand Xia Emperor, only to face the terrifying wrath of a True Immortal.
twitter_title: Ji Ning's Monster Power Stuns the Grand Xia!
twitter_description: A Void Fiendgod just one-shot a legendary formation. The Xia Emperor wants him as an ally. A True Immortal wants him dead. The stakes are through the roof!

lore_anchors.definition: A legendary defensive-offensive formation derived from the Xuanwu Emperor's innate ability, combining an impenetrable defense with space-devouring attacks. Considered near-invincible below the Empyrean God/True Immortal level.

One of the ten great divine abilities since Pangu, passed down from the legendary archer Houyi. It draws upon the power of the heavens and the earth, making each arrow cataclysmically powerful but extremely costly in Heartforce.
A True Immortal who has mastered the Grand Dao of Space. He is the senior brother of the Zicao Celestial Immortal and arrives in a blind rage to avenge her death.
A level of cultivation above True Immortal, marking a qualitative leap in power and foundation. Ji Ning’s power is compared to this level as a benchmark of his terrifying potential.

A core concept in Xianxia politics where a powerful cultivator is morally (and karmically) obligated to repay a favor. The ancient imperial clan leverages this to build alliances by helping prodigies before they rise to power.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How did Ji Ning, a Void Fiendgod, shatter the Tortoise-Serpent Formation so easily?
cultural_notes_faq.a: His personal combat power had already crossed the threshold of a Pure Yang True Immortal due to his supreme divine abilities and Dao comprehension, making the formation's defensive limits meaningless against his focused strike.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is the Xia Emperor so eager to help Ji Ning?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The ancient imperial clan's power is built on a network of grateful allies. By helping a monster genius like Ji Ning now, the Emperor secures a future powerhouse who will be karmically obligated to help him in return.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why couldn't Ji Ning and the others teleport away?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Flowinghua True Immortal, who has mastered the Grand Dao of Space, sealed the space around the battlefield, making Greater Teleportation impossible.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Ji Ning stop firing arrows after seven shots?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Houyi Archery Art is extremely draining on Heartforce. With his current Heartforce level, Ji Ning could only manage seven full-powered shots before being exhausted.
